accepted.quote: Taken together, these changes would empower employers to pocket money earned by their employees, make earnings less predictable for many workers, and apply the tipped credit to workers currently covered by the standard minimum wage protections.
accepted.rationale: The passage portrays H.R. 2312 as expanding subminimum-wage coverage and reducing earnings predictability, supporting stronger wage protections.
